independent_unit: one separately generated historical sample; methods share future noise within the sample

histories.evaluation_sampling: fixed stratification: three independent historical draws per true family; no pooled iid binomial interval

definitions.J: attained local full joint AC whitened SSE
definitions.M: min wrong-candidate J minus true-candidate J; log-likelihood margin=M/2
definitions.noiseless_M: same saved noisy H plus true future mean; offline evaluation only
definitions.RX: Euclidean norm of fitted-minus-true edge R or X, divided by Euclidean norm of true edge R or X, under the true candidate
definitions.proxy_completed: saved gap_reached stopping condition for frozen local surrogate
definitions.risk_unresolved: more than one candidate retained; may overlap false rejection

risk.statistic: T_a=J_a-min_b J_b; reject a iff T_a exceeds its calibrated threshold
risk.guarantee_scope: marginal over calibration histories and one new independent history under the declared exchangeable simulation reference

timing.scope: saved per-history wall time includes generation, historical fitting, selection/prediction and noisy/noiseless evaluation of all eleven methods; four workers ran concurrently; not a single-method exclusive benchmark

random_isolation.source_check: ev_compact_study.select_controls generates random comparator after both primary refinements; deterministic INHERITS and initial sets exclude random

saved_data_audit.QP_derivative_scope: matched frozen AC derivative code; not an independent analytic-derivative proof

limitations: twelve simulated independent evaluation histories, four candidates in a three-terminal local problem
asset-family physical bounds use public cable parameters and synthetic lengths; no measured field lower bound
local AC fits are attained likelihood values, not globally certified MLE
finite-time MILP surrogate completion differs by domain and is separate from physical feasibility
all charging-service controls share terminal SOC, but grid energy and throughput differ because conversion and travel losses differ
neither mean margin nor calibrated counts are topology probabilities
